requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: A non-upgradeable contract governed by a 3-of-4 set of unidentified keys with a 200 s dispute window. The last live read recorded over $544M still held, though the docs call it deprecated in favor of Circle CCTP.
narrative.detail: Withdrawals and admin changes need more than 2/3 of an equal-weight hot or cold set, currently 4 keys installed at epoch 7 by an emergencyUnlock transaction. Any 2 lockers can pause a pending change within the 200 s window. None of the 8 bridge keys matches any of the 35 registered L1 validator or signer addresses. Why the set is a fixed 4-key committee instead of tracking the 27 active validators, an intentional freeze or a sync that stopped, cannot be told from chain data and is left unresolved. Docs say the bridge holds under 10% of HyperCore USDC.

independent_read.why: no code at this address on the chain's mainnet: a derived identifier for a native (non-EVM) entity such as HyperCore, or a contract that lives on another chain (a rollup's own L1 contracts); nothing for this reader to compare here
